generated.details: On the mid-plane right desktop beside the laptop, the low ivory ceramic desk tray has a shallow flat basin and continuous softly rounded raised rim.
Farther right within reach, the clear glass paperweight is a palm-sized solid dome with a flat base resting directly on the wood.

A slate blue powder-coated perforated metal panel occupies a broad rectangle across the far-plane upper-center and right wall; evenly punched round holes and folded perimeter returns give it depth above concealed wall mounts.
